summary: The filing is a Form 8-K reporting the establishment of a new series of preferred stock (Series D) via a Certificate of Designation. It describes the ranking, dividend, and redemption terms of the preferred shares. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. This is a routine capital structure event, not a special situation.
